parameters.pythonCode:
from telethon import TelegramClient

# === CONFIGURATION ===
api_id = 1234567           # Remplace par ton API ID (my.telegram.org)
api_hash = 'xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx'  # Remplace par ton API Hash
phone_number = '+213xxxxxxxxx'   # Ton numéro Telegram au format international
message = "Salut 👋, message envoyé depuis n8n avec Telethon !"

# === INITIALISATION DU CLIENT ===
client = TelegramClient("n8n_session", api_id, api_hash)

async def main():
    await client.start(phone_number)
    # Envoie un message à toi-même
    await client.send_message("me", message)
    print("✅ Message envoyé avec succès !")

with client:
    client.loop.run_until_complete(main())

DELETE FROM discussion 
WHERE id < (
    SELECT MIN(keep_id) FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT phone_number, 
               nth_value(id, 20) OVER (
                   PARTITION BY phone_number 
                   ORDER BY id DESC 
                   ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING
               ) as keep_id
        FROM discussion
    ) limits
    WHERE limits.phone_number = discussion.phone_number
    AND keep_id IS NOT NULL
);
